portal.favoritesHint: Click the star on an app to put it here
portal.noFavorites: No favourites yet. Click the star on any button to keep it here.
portal.emptyTab: There are no buttons on this tab yet.
portal.loadFailed: The portal could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

errors.microsoft_not_connected: Sign in with your Microsoft account to see your mail and calendar here.
errors.microsoft_consent_missing: The portal may not read your mail or calendar yet. Sign in again, or ask IT to give consent in Microsoft Entra.
errors.microsoft_unreachable: Microsoft 365 cannot be reached right now.
errors.generic: This block cannot be loaded right now.

tv.title: Now on TV
tv.unavailable: The programme guide cannot be reached.
tv.nothing: No programme in the guide right now

admin.appsIntro: Make a tab per workplace and put buttons on it. Drag to change the order.
admin.sectionHint: A section is a heading on a tab, for example Broadcast or Technology.
admin.iconHint: Shown when there is no logo.
admin.linkHint: The address that opens, starting with https:// or http://.
admin.descriptionPlaceholder: One sentence, e.g. Week planning, blocks and the library.
admin.noGroupsYet: Everyone sees it. Add Microsoft groups under Groups to limit who sees a tab or button.
admin.newWindow: Open in a new browser tab
admin.checkHealthHint: The portal checks every minute whether the app answers.
admin.healthUrlHint: Leave empty to check the link itself.
admin.logoHint: PNG, SVG, WebP or JPEG, at most 1 MB. Square works best.
admin.emptyTab: This tab is still empty. Add a button or a section.
admin.confirmDeleteTab: Delete this tab and all buttons on it?
admin.confirmDeleteSection: Delete this section? Its buttons stay on the tab.
admin.noticesIntro: A message at the top of the portal, for everyone, between a start and end time.
admin.textEnHint: Optional: English-speaking colleagues see the Dutch text when this is empty.
admin.groupsIntro: Microsoft groups you can use to show a tab or button only to some colleagues.
admin.groupsClaimHint: The portal reads the groups from the Microsoft sign-in. In the app registration in Entra, add the groups claim under Token configuration (security groups, as object ID). Colleagues see their group items after their next sign-in.
admin.noGroups: No groups yet: everyone sees every tab and button.
admin.objectIdHint: Entra admin center > Groups > the group > Object ID.
admin.settingsIntro: Name, Microsoft 365 blocks and Now on TV.
admin.ssoHint: Sign-in with Microsoft is set up under System > Single sign-on. Use the IJmond 360 tenant ID so only colleagues can sign in.
admin.m365Intro: Mail and calendar blocks on the start page.
admin.m365Consent: The Microsoft sign-in then also asks to read mail and calendar (Mail.Read, Calendars.Read). Add these delegated permissions to the app registration in Entra and grant admin consent once, so colleagues do not get a consent question.
admin.tvIntro: The current and next programme from the TV Station Manager programme guide, with the live stream.
admin.tvEnabled: Show Now on TV on the start page
admin.xmltvHint: TV Station Manager > EPG: the XMLTV address with token.
admin.tvChannelHint: XMLTV channel id, e.g. tvsm.1. Empty = the first channel.
admin.streamUrlHint: Owncast /embed/video page, .m3u8 or .mp4. Empty = no video.
admin.tvLinkHint: For example the Now on TV page of TV Station Manager.

errors.unknown_group: One of the chosen groups no longer exists.
errors.unknown_section: That section is not on this tab.
errors.home_tab: The start tab cannot be deleted.
errors.group_exists: A group with this object ID already exists.
errors.group_in_use: This group is still used by a tab or button.
errors.order_mismatch: Someone else changed this list. Reload the page.
errors.unsupported_image: Use a PNG, SVG, WebP or JPEG image.
errors.logo_too_large: The logo is larger than 1 MB.
errors.validation_failed: Check the fields: something is missing or not valid.
